_review: The stuck layer (docs/direction.md §2.2 layer 4, M3b; systems/stuck.js). Keyed by quest/step. When the Wraith has spent `after` seconds within `near` m of a step's goal (or anywhere, without `near`) and the step has not moved on, `by` (a person who would plausibly be there or call out) says the next line: one more piece, never the answer. Each line is said once; the next waits another `after`.

lines: Garrow said the vents stand low, like stumps of stone. Look for turf grown over stone.
If the turf will not come off, get close to it and pull. It is only sod.
Over here! By the last stone, near the edge!
Wait behind a stone until it has gone past, then run to the next one!
Go on ahead of me. I only move when it has just gone past.
Get to the next stone up the gap, and I will come.
Hold on to it and climb, like a tree. The shutters are on its sides, not only the front.
Close to a shutter, strike it. Rust gives if you hit it hard enough.
The sled is under the dune just north of the camp. Look for the runner tips sticking out of the sand.
The Walker lies east of the Stride, on the great star dune. Follow the glass the storm left, east.
When it wakes, climb onto its back. Its pillars steer it.
Steer it west, to the Wellhouse. The tall pillars turn it. The song makes them turn harder.
